name: Olive Trail, Naukluft
why: A short loop up onto a high plateau and back down a narrow gorge, with a chain to hold on the rock.
book: Book at Naukluft reception. The trailhead is a car park about 4 km north of the camp. Follow the yellow footprints.
water: None on the trail: carry 2 litres.
dangers: In the gorge a fixed chain helps you along a steep rock section.
No shade on the plateau: start early.
turnaround: Not on the plateau by 11:00 in the warm months: go back the way you came.

points.name: Olive Trail car park
points.note: The track end north of the camp. The path climbs north-west onto the plateau.

points.name: Olive Trail plateau
points.note: The high point of the loop, about 1,870 m, with views over the Naukluft Mountains.

points.name: Chain section in the gorge
points.note: The narrow gorge on the way back, where a chain helps you along the rock. Then down the valley to the car park.
